overview: Step back in time as you explore Vietnam's rich history, cruise through Halong Bay, uncover Hoa Lu's history, and bike through its scenic landscapes.
Explore the historic Hoa Lu, Vietnam's ancient capital, home to the intricately carved temples dedicated to founding kings.
Venture through the countryside on two wheels as you cycle from Tam Coc to the enchanting Bich Dong Pagoda.
Cruise through Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site, surrounded by breathtaking limestone karsts and emerald waters.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi
days.body: B egin your Vietnam adventure as you arrive at the Noi Bai International Airport and get transferred to the hotel to check in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure by exploring nearby attractions on your own. Visit Ngoc Son Temple, dedicated to General Tran Hung Dao, a Vietnamese hero. Admire the iconic red The Huc Bridge leading to the temple and enjoy serene views of Hoan Kiem Lake. Conclude your day by returning to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh
days.body: Begin this day by onboarding your pre-booked transfer for a day trip to Ninh Binh city. Visit the Hoa Lu temples, the ancient capital of Vietnam, once home to the Dinh and Le Dynasties, after whom many attractions in the area are named. Afterwards, explore the limestone caves of Tam Coc on a boat ride (at an extra cost) from Hao Lu. From there, enjoy a cycling adventure to Bich Dong Pagoda before getting transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
days.body: Get ready for a cruise adventure after checking out of the hotel and getting transferred to Halong Bay. Upon arrival, embark on a Halong Bay cruise at Tuan Chau Harbour. Stop by Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village to enjoy recreational activities like kayaking and swimming. Also, learn how to cook Vietnamese cuisine onboard. Conclude your day with an overnight stay in the cabin as the cruise glides through the limestone karst (hollowed rock formations) and pristine waters of Halong Bay.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi · Leisure Day
days.body: As a new day dawns, continue your Halong Bay adventure by engaging in a Tai Chi (martial art) lesson and visiting the largest caves of Halong Bay, the Surprise Caves (also called the Sung Sot Cave). Following that, deboard the cruise, get transferred to Hanoi and check in at the hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure by exploring attractions like Ho Chi Minh's Mausoleum and the Temple Of Literature on your own. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.body: Your Vietnam trip concludes as you check out from the hotel and get transferred to the Noi Bai International Airport for your departure. Have a safe journey ahead!
